mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month decline in the federal funds rate signals an easing monetary cycle that compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained upward movement in the unemployment rate above 7.5% triggers a loss of labor market confidence, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns in triggered instances are not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC < 0.03 over 1-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in both billings (GDPC1) and housing starts (HOUST) signals robust demand growth, which expands corporate profits and equity valuations, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window, or 60-day forward returns in rising demand periods not significantly higher than baseline (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: During a monetary tightening cycle (FEDFUNDS >4.5%), rising interest rates compress equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day returns in tightening periods not significantly negative (p > 0.05) or Rank IC < 0.03 over 2-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp decline in the industrial production index (INDPRO) exceeding 2% in a month signals tight supply conditions, potentially reducing production costs and boosting corporate profits, resulting in positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day returns not significantly positive (p > 0.05) or Rank IC < 0.03 over 1-month window.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent rises in billings (GDPC1) and payrolls (HOUST) indicate robust demand growth, expanding corporate earnings and equity valuations, which drive positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window, or 60-day forward returns in rising demand-payrolls periods not significantly higher than baseline (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A combination of rising unemployment (UNRATE) above 7.5% and declining payrolls (PAYEMS) below 130,000 signals labor market weakening, reducing consumer spending and corporate profits, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE rises >0.2pp AND PAYEMS falls >5,000 in 1 month
failure_condition: 20-day returns in recessionary instances not significantly negative (p > 0.05) or Rank IC < 0.03 over 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained upward trend in billings (GDPC1) over three months reflects robust demand growth, which expands corporate profits and equity valuations, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day returns in rising demand periods not significantly positive (p > 0.05) or Rank IC < 0.03 over 2-year window.
